devdoc.details: See base contract for the full design rationale (LZ payload-size bypass,      trust model, strict one-shot semantics).

execute().details: Preconditions (handled by the wrapping VIP, not this contract):      - This helper has been granted `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` on the local ACM        (one-time setup VIP — `acm.grantRole(0x00, helper)`).      - The Normal Timelock has accepted ownership of every contract whose admin        functions this helper calls (DeviationSentinel, SentinelOracle, EBrake,        UniswapOracle, plus CurveOracle on Ethereum / AerodromeOracle on Base).

devdoc.title: DeviationSentinelConfiguratorEthereum

OnlyTimelock().notice: Reverts when `execute()` is called by anyone other than NORMAL_TIMELOCK.

ACM().notice: Local AccessControlManager — gates every grant/revoke this helper performs.

CORE_COMPTROLLER().notice: Core Pool Comptroller — host of the EBrake action permissions.

CRITICAL_TIMELOCK().notice: Critical Timelock (governance account, granted same admin perms as Normal).

EBRAKE().notice: EBrakeV2 — recipient of Comptroller emergency-action perms.

FAST_TRACK_TIMELOCK().notice: Fast-Track Timelock (governance account, granted same admin perms as Normal).

GUARDIAN().notice: Guardian multisig (granted admin perms alongside the three Timelocks).

KEEPER().notice: Off-chain keeper EOA — the primary `handleDeviation` caller on DeviationSentinel.

MULTISIG_PAUSER().notice: 1-of-1 Venus team multisig — granted EBrake action perms (Phase 0 manual ops).

NORMAL_TIMELOCK().notice: Normal Timelock — the only authorized caller of `execute()`.

SENTINEL_ORACLE().notice: SentinelOracle — token → DEX oracle indirection layer.

UNISWAP_ORACLE().notice: UniswapOracle — DEX oracle for every Uniswap V3 monitored market.

execute().notice: Applies the entire VIP-616 + VIP-617 bootstrap atomically.

userdoc.notice: Ethereum mainnet child of DeviationSentinelConfigurator. Adds the CurveOracle         bootstrap (EBTC/WBTC StableSwap-NG pool) on top of the 9 Uniswap V3 markets.
